Definition: to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve
BiblicalUsage: 1) to open; 1a) (Qal) to open; 1b) (Niphal) to be opened, be let loose, be thrown open; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to free; 1c2) to loosen; 1c3) to open, open oneself; 1d) (Hithpael) to loose oneself; 2) to carve, engrave; 2a) (Piel) to engrave; 2b) (Pual) to be engraved
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
